propositions: Validation logic is sometimes implemented only in CLI commands while MCP/library/reconciler code paths bypass it, creating inconsistent enforcement.
The plan-review registry lacks a criterion to detect and advise on engine-layer enforcement placement decisions.

Adding project.engine-layer-enforcement as an ADVISORY criterion with deterministic trigger on file_impact touching src/rebar/_commands/ or validation/guard modules will flag CLI-only validation placement.
The criterion should teach reviewers to prefer engine-seam placement over interface-local validation without blocking legitimate interface-local choices.
Registry routing overlay and generated criteria guide must be updated to support the new criterion and enable rebar explain to serve its definition.
